description:
Promote the mix task to a supervised, non-hotpath service: placement, scheduling, telemetry (packs written, objects reclaimed, bytes moved, pass duration) and configuration for the byte cap and the staleness bound.

Add single-flight. Concurrent consolidators cannot corrupt anything — identical plans produce identical bytes at identical keys, and both puts and deletes are idempotent — so this is churn control, not a correctness requirement. Single-instance scheduling is sufficient. If that cannot be guaranteed, an advisory per-shard lease costs nothing new: the ObjectStorage behaviour already has get_with_version/2 and put_if_version_matches/5, and a lease expiring early is harmless for the same reason concurrency is.

Cap guidance: ChunkReader.read_chunk/2 fetches whole objects into memory, so the practical cap is bounded by what is acceptable to materialize per pull, per shard, per concurrent puller — not by the 4 GiB that the 32-bit directory offsets permit. Raising it meaningfully means ranged reads first (Chunk.byte_range_from_version/2 exists and is unused outside tests), which is deliberately not a dependency of this epic.
title: Consolidator: periodic service, placement and telemetry
